feeds.title: Cancer Dietitian Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyle tips for prevention and survivorship. Covers Cancer Prevention, Cancer side effect tips, Recipes Low FODMAP diet, Meal planning Cancer diets, and Organic food discussions. Author Julie Lanford is a registered dietitian, licensed nutritionist, and board-certified specialist in oncology nutrition, providing a practical and positive approach to healthy eating.

feeds.title: Jean LaMantia Blog
feeds.description: Covers credible information about cancer diets, recipes for cancer risk reduction, and lymphedema. Author Jean LaMantia is a registered dietitian, author, cancer survivor, and professional speaker.

feeds.title: Food To Glow
feeds.description: Covers articles on Gluten-free, Sauce, soft food diet,, Vegan, easy recipe, lower carb and more. Food To Glow is a healthy, plant-focused omnivore with an occasional decadent twist. Kellie Anderson is a health educator, food writer and recipe developer.

feeds.title: The Anti Cancer Kitchen
feeds.description: Covers a range of topics including Cancer Fighting Foods, Cancer Lifestyle, Raw Plant-based recipes, and more. The authors want to raise awareness about the connection between cancer and food.

feeds.title: American Institute for Cancer Research Blog
feeds.description: Blog posts contain information on how to persevere when experiencing the long-term effects of cancer as well as healthy lifestyle choices. The American Institute for Cancer Research funds cutting-edge research to help prevent and survive cancer.
